create_watermarker: create a StableDiffusionXLWatermarker instance to embed invisible watermarks into generated images
apply_watermark_to_images: apply an invisible DWT-DCT watermark to a batch of torch tensor images
review_watermark_bits: review the WATERMARK_BITS constant that encodes the Stability AI watermark message as binary bits
review_watermark_message: review the WATERMARK_MESSAGE constant that holds the Stability AI watermark as a binary integer
test_apply_watermark: test the apply_watermark method to verify it skips images smaller than 256 pixels
